lines: Tuten is getting more carries lately, 18.0 per game over his last three games versus 16.4 for the season, while playing 52% of snaps.
He scored 19.7 PPR points per game over that stretch, with 4.7 red zone carries and targets per game, but just 2.0 targets per game.
Coach Coen said he is the featured runner but is playing through an ankle issue. The Giants allow the 27th-most PPR points per game to backs.
